title: Harry Edison's wit
summary: Wilson and Hinton praise Edison as a character and fantastic player.

blocks.x: I'll tell you who turns that kind of stuff on nowadays is Harry Edison. You ever see Harry Edison tangle up with musicians, they get kidding around, ride each other.
Yeah, 'Seen better days on a farm,' he used to say, something like that. Yeah, Sweets is quite a character and a fantastic player.
Yeah, to me he's playing a lot more trumpet than ______ was when he came over to Basie's.
That's right. He's very happy these days.
